title: add vpc control plane provisioning: subnets, endpoints, security-groups, peering, dns (terraform)
author: Priya Raman
description:
Motivation: Add a Terraform-backed VPC control plane provisioning module for private deployments (VPC-based control plane). This PR implements subnet allocation templates, interface and gateway endpoints, recommended security group rules for control plane components, cross-account peering wiring, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation guidance. The goal is to provide an opinionated, idempotent Terraform module that operators can drop into Private deployments (VPC or cross-account) and share configuration across cloud accounts/regions.

What this changes: single continuous description string with sections condensed: - New module `modules/vpc-control-plane/` with main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf and examples. - Subnet allocation supports single-az and multi-az patterns and exposes map outputs for control-plane endpoint placement. - Interface endpoints (SSM, KMS, ECR, STS) and optional gateway endpoints (S3) are created when enabled. - Security group module creates minimal allowed ingress/egress for control-plane services and supports append-only operator rules for customer-specific exceptions. - Cross-account peering resources and optional Route53 Resolver rules for DNS forwarding between control plane VPC and customer VPCs. - Upgrade hooks: migration plan for existing private-installer stacks, explicit terraform state import guidance and automated terraform plan checks in CI.

Testing & validation: module includes an example `examples/multi-az` with terratest-like validation scripts and a small integration test run against a sandbox account that verifies endpoint connectivity, SG rules, and DNS resolution. CI added a smoke plan/apply job gated to a test account. Manual validation checklist included for on-prem/private customers who prefer offline review.

Backward compatibility & rollout: Default vars preserve existing behavior (no changes to existing installs). The module is additive; operators must opt into peering/DNS features. For existing clusters, migration docs and rollback commands are included (terraform state rollback guidance + terraform destroy --target for selective rollback).

Security considerations: KMS keys referenced are customer-managed by default. Endpoints follow least-privilege patterns. No secrets are stored in state; sensitive outputs are flagged.

Checklist: - [x] Terraform module + examples - [x] Integration smoke tests - [x] Documentation updates (README + migration guide) - [x] CI job & plan gating - [x] Reviewed and approved by networking and security

Notes: See linked Linear tasks ENG-1423 and ENG-1489 for detailed acceptance criteria and PM context. This PR consolidates previous ad-hoc scripts in `scripts/terraform/` into the new module and deprecates `scripts/terraform/vpc-quickstart` after a one-release transition.
